chapter: Barnet, 52nd Street and New York recording dates
title: Timme Rosenkrantz's apartment recordings of Erroll Garner
summary: A collector recorded Garner by the hour and later issued the records cheaply in Europe, undercutting Garner's sales.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Somebody said there was a building where an awful lot of recording took place. You'd make a record in one small studio, and you'd walk out in the hall and somebody would grab you and take you into another studio, and you'd be recording with somebody else. I can't remember (inaudible).

I don't know exactly what building that was, but -- it was -- recording was going on all over that place then, but they had a lot of good studios around there then, you know. The building might not have been much, but the recording facilities were good, you know, and Errol Garner was -- they had a guy around there then that had -- he had an apartment down in the Village, and his name was Timmy Rosenkrantz, and Timmy had a very expensive equipment down there in his apartment.

And he used to bring Errol Garner down there and just record him by the hour, and he'd give him all the liquor he want and anything else he want, have chicks for him down there and food. And when Errol got popular, man, all of this stuff came out in Europe, man. This guy made a fortune.

All of these things started coming out in Europe, you know, and it kind of really hurt Erroll's sales on his own recordings he made because they were putting out -- like his albums were selling for five, six or seven bucks, and these -- this guy was putting these things out for $3.00, you know, over there, had all -- oh, lot of the same tunes and a lot of
the same things, but these were some of the things that have gone on, man, and they still go on in music, you know.

But you can't blame -- you can't blame the guy for do -- if he hadn't done it, probably somebody else would have done it, but the bad thing was they were supposed to have been friends, you know. This is how that thing works, you know. There's so much of that went on.
